info.name: Gazebo — Locations & Products
info.description:
## Overview

Local Django microservice APIs for **locations/containers** and **products**.

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000`)

## Response envelope

```json
{
  "status": "success|error",
  "message": "...",
  "data": {}
}
```

## Product routes

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET/POST | `/product/` | List active / create core product |
| GET/PATCH/DELETE | `/product/:id/` | Detail / partial update / soft-deactivate |
| GET/PUT/DELETE | `/product/:id/flags/` | Attribute flags (full replace on PUT) |
| GET/PUT/DELETE | `/product/:id/technical/` | Technical satellite |
| GET/POST | `/product/:id/allergens/` | Allergens collection |
| GET/PUT/DELETE | `/product/:id/nutrition/` | Nutrition |
| GET/PUT/DELETE | `/product/:id/ingredient-label/` | Ingredient label |
| GET/PUT/DELETE | `/product/:id/acceptance/` | Acceptance |

## Demo seed

- Product: `id=900001` Peri Peri Burger (`python manage.py seed_demo_product`)
- Containers: `900001`–`900004`
- Lookups: class/category/range/unit ids `9001` (+ unit case `9002`)

## Containers

Containers are `loc_location` rows. Use `GET /container/` for a flat list (useful for `source_container_id` / `destination_container_id`).

request.description:
### List all containers

`GET /container/`

Returns a flat list of all locations (containers) for FK selection when creating products.

**Query params**
| Param | Description |
|---|---|
| `q` | Filter by name (icontains) |
| `visible` | `true` / `false` |

**Success `data`**
- `count` — number of rows
- `results[]` — `{ id, container_id, name, external_code, visible, static, locked, roles }`
- `endpoints` — related route map

### Location tree list

`GET /container/locations/`

Richer hierarchy-oriented location listing (tree). Prefer `/container/` for simple product FK dropdowns.

item.name: Products
item.description:
Product master APIs (core identity + classification).

- Collection: `GET|POST /product/`
- Detail: `GET|PATCH|DELETE /product/:id/`

request.description:
### List products

`GET /product/`

Returns active products (`is_active=true`).

**Success `data`** — array of:
```json
{
  "id": 900001,
  "name": "Peri Peri Burger",
  "alternate_name": "PP Burger",
  "recipe_code": "PPB-001",
  "is_active": true,
  "product_class_id": 9001,
  "category_id": 9001,
  "range_id": 9001,
  "unit_id": 9001
}
```

### Get product detail

`GET /product/:id/`

Returns full core product fields including container FKs and timestamps.

**404** if product does not exist.

**Success `data`** includes list fields plus:
`alternate_recipe_code`, `gff_code`, `secondary_gff_recipe`, `external_barcode`, `is_downtime`, `purchasing_version`, `ingredient_count`, `remarks`, `sub_range_id`, `purchasing_unit_id`, `purchase_shape_format_id`, `source_container_id`, `destination_container_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`

request.description:
### Create product

`POST /product/`

Creates a **core** `product` row only (no satellite tables yet).

#### Required body fields
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | int | Explicit PK (legacy-compatible) |
| `name` | string | Unique |
| `product_class_id` | int | Must exist |
| `category_id` | int | Must exist |
| `range_id` | int | Must exist |
| `unit_id` | int | Must exist |
| `source_container_id` | int | `GET /container/` |
| `destination_container_id` | int | `GET /container/` |

#### Optional
`alternate_name`, `recipe_code`, `alternate_recipe_code`, `gff_code`, `secondary_gff_recipe`, `external_barcode`, `is_active`, `is_downtime`, `purchasing_version`, `ingredient_count`, `remarks`, `sub_range_id`, `purchasing_unit_id`, `purchase_shape_format_id`

#### Status codes
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Validation / missing fields / bad FK |
| 409 | `id` already exists |

**Tip:** Call `GET /container/` first to pick container ids. Demo lookups use id `9001`.

### Update product (partial)

`PATCH /product/:id/`

Partial update of core product fields. Only keys present in the body are applied.

Lookup FKs are validated when provided. Nullable optional FKs: `sub_range_id`, `purchasing_unit_id`, `purchase_shape_format_id`.

#### Status codes
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Updated |
| 400 | Invalid JSON / bad FK / validation |
| 404 | Product not found |

### Soft-deactivate product

`DELETE /product/:id/`

Sets `is_active=false` (soft delete). Returns the updated product detail.

**404** if product does not exist.

item.name: Product Flags
item.description:
Attribute flags for stock, recipe and planning.

`GET|PUT|DELETE /product/:id/flags/`

- **PUT** = full replace — omitted boolean keys default to `false`
- Excludes `record_flag`; chilling loss **factor** lives on yield, not flags
- Product must exist for PUT/DELETE (404 if not)

request.description:
### Save product flags (full replace)

`PUT /product/:id/flags/`

Creates or updates the flags row (`update_or_create`).

**Semantics:** omitted keys → `false`. Send the full set of flags you care about.

#### Flag fields (17)
| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `in_stock_list` | Include in global stock list |
| `auto_yield` | Automatically calculate yield |
| `has_plan` | Has plan |
| `auto_rate` | Automatically calculate rate |
| `auto_clear_stock` | Automatically clear stock residuals |
| `consider_stock_in_plan` | Consider stock in plan |
| `has_recipe` | Has recipe |
| `full_batches_only` | Full batches only |
| `auto_trends` | Automatically calculate trend |
| `is_implicit` | Implicit stock auto consumption |
| `include_in_projections` | Include in sales projections |
| `has_chilling_loss` | Has chilling / process loss |
| `use_batch_quantity` | Use batch quantity for stock |
| `freezer_no_deduct` | Exempt 2-day defrost deduction |
| `is_purchase_item` | Purchase item |
| `is_sales_item` | Sales item |
| `is_dispatch_support` | Dispatch support |

#### Status codes
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Updated existing flags |
| 201 | Created flags row |
| 400 | Invalid JSON |
| 404 | Product not found |

### Delete product flags

`DELETE /product/:id/flags/`

Removes the flags row for the product.

#### Status codes
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Deleted (`data: null`) |
| 404 | Product not found, or flags row missing |
